notes: Example add-on: Keelhaul Freight's story. A news arc that, after a while, sets the flag the exchange file maps to an 8% rise; and the exchange's own bought event for this company, which an add-on may name because Phobos Exchange registers the exchange namespace (exchange-<prefix>-...).

keelhaul-contract-news.text: Cassini Spaceport has given its seasonal ore contract to Keelhaul Freight, a belt line better known for hauling plate than for winning tenders. Dock workers at Zhonghuamen Terminal expect longer queues at the ore chutes.

keelhaul-titan-contract.title: Keelhaul wins the Titan ore contract

exchange-keelhaul-freight-bought.title: A letter from Keelhaul's shareholder desk

message.text: Your name came across the share register this morning. Keelhaul hauls ore and plate, mostly on time. The board asks nothing of small holders; I write because it is polite, and because ore prices at Zhonghuamen move us more than any speech will.
